name: Logitech C920s Pro HD Webcam
description: A Full HD 1080p webcam with autofocus, automatic light correction, dual stereo microphones and a privacy shutter. A practical option for online classes and video meetings.

name: Dell Pro 3 Webcam 2K (WB3023)
description: A 2K QHD webcam supporting up to 2560 × 1440 resolution at 60 fps, with a 78° field of view, autofocus and built-in microphone. Check device and software compatibility before buying.

name: Logitech MX Keys S Wireless Keyboard
description: A low-profile wireless keyboard with smart backlighting, programmable keys and multi-device switching. Designed for comfortable, precise typing at a desk.

name: Anker USB-C Hub (7-in-1)
description: A compact USB-C hub that adds multiple connections, including HDMI, USB and card access. The manufacturer lists 4K at 60Hz HDMI output and up to 85W charging; verify your laptop's USB-C capabilities.

name: Samsung T7 Shield Portable SSD (1TB)
description: A rugged 1TB portable SSD with USB 3.2 Gen 2, IP65-rated protection and advertised sequential read/write speeds of up to 1,050/1,000 MB/s. Actual speeds depend on the connected device and setup.

name: JBL Flip 6 Portable Bluetooth Speaker
description: A compact Bluetooth speaker with IP67 water and dust resistance and up to 12 hours of advertised playtime. A practical pick for travel and everyday listening.

name: TP-Link Tapo C210 Pan/Tilt Home Security Camera
description: An indoor pan-and-tilt Wi-Fi camera with 2K resolution, motion detection and two-way audio. Check local privacy rules and storage options before purchase.

name: Ninja Air Fryer (AF101)
description: A compact air fryer designed for air frying, roasting, reheating and dehydrating. Check basket capacity and counter space to make sure it suits your household.

name: Instant Pot Duo 7-in-1 Electric Pressure Cooker
description: A multi-cooker that combines pressure cooking, slow cooking, steaming, sautéing, rice cooking, yogurt making and warming. Choose the capacity that fits your family size.

name: Oral-B iO Series 5 Electric Toothbrush
description: An electric toothbrush with a pressure sensor and app-connected brushing guidance. Brush-head replacements and regional availability should be checked before buying.

name: Philips OneBlade Hybrid Trimmer
description: A rechargeable grooming tool designed to trim, edge and shave facial hair. Check the exact model and included attachments, as kits vary by market.

name: Herschel Classic Backpack
description: A simple everyday backpack for commuting, study and travel. Compare the selected size, laptop sleeve details and fabric before ordering.

name: Casio G-Shock DW-5600 Digital Watch
description: A durable digital watch with shock resistance, stopwatch, countdown timer and water resistance. Confirm the exact DW-5600 variant and dimensions before purchase.

name: Google Fitbit Charge 6 Fitness Tracker
description: A fitness tracker with activity and heart-rate tracking, built-in GPS and up to 7 days of advertised battery life. Feature availability and some insights may depend on app, phone and subscription.

name: Manduka PRO Yoga Mat
description: A dense, durable yoga mat designed for regular practice and studio use. It is a premium, heavier mat, so check dimensions and weight before ordering.

name: Owala FreeSip Insulated Water Bottle
description: An insulated stainless-steel bottle with a dual-purpose FreeSip spout for sipping or using the built-in straw. Check size, lid care and colour availability.

name: Hydro Flask 32 oz Wide Mouth Bottle
description: A reusable insulated bottle for everyday hydration, commuting and outdoor use. Check lid compatibility and bottle dimensions before purchase.
